The '''Tagge Restaurant Association''' was a subsidiary of [[Tagge Company/Legends|TaggeCo]]. It owned the popular [[Biscuit Baron]] [[fast food]] chain. A "macro-farming" corporation, it greatly benefited from essential [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] agricultural labor under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
